post.description:
Authenticate and return JWT.

Timing-attack prevention: always run Argon2 verification even on unknown
emails so the response time is indistinguishable from a real failure.

Register a new user.

(DEVELOPER, TESTER). Higher roles must be created by ORG_ADMIN or above.

SUPERVISOR+ can list all users in their company.

post.description:
Initiate password reset — sends a reset link via email.

ALWAYS returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists,
to prevent user enumeration attacks.

Complete the password reset flow.

Validates the token, updates the password hash, and marks the token as used.
Token expires after 1 hour and is single-use.

Verify email address using the token sent during registration.

Clears the verification token after use.

Resend the email verification link for the current user.

Generates a new token and queues it for email delivery.
Create a new bug report.

get.description:
Full-text search on bug title + description using Postgres tsvector.
Returns bugs ranked by relevance.

patch.description: Update bug metadata. Status cannot be changed here — use /transition.

post.description:
Assign a bug to a user.
All business logic is in services/assignment.py.

patch.description:
Move a bug to a new lifecycle status.
All validation is in services/lifecycle.py (transition table + role check).

get.description:
Return the list of statuses the caller can transition this bug to.
Frontend uses this to render context-aware buttons.

post.description: Upload a file attachment to a bug (max size configurable via MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB).

get.description: List all non-deleted attachments for a bug.

post.description: Add a 'bug A blocks bug B' dependency relationship.
Subscribe to notifications for this bug.

delete.description: Unsubscribe from notifications for this bug.

post.description:
Trigger an AutoRepro execution for the given bug.

Execution pre-flight (enforced inside trigger_autorepro service):
  1. Quota & Subscription Limits (from usage service)
  2. Bug exists and is not deleted
  3. Bug must be IN_PROGRESS
  4. attempt_number <= max_attempts (unless MANAGER+)

get.description:
Get job detail.
Redis cache is checked first (fast polling path); DB is the fallback.
List all execution jobs scoped to the caller's company.

post.description:
Cancel a running or pending job.

Sets a Redis cancel signal that the worker polls.
Also marks the job as FAILED with cancelled_at timestamp.
The worker detects this signal and stops cleanly.

get.description:
Download a ZIP archive of job artifacts: logs, script, and screenshots.

Uses streaming response to avoid loading large files into memory.

delete.description: Soft-delete a comment. Authors can delete their own; MANAGER+ can delete any.

Response metadata includes unread_count for badge rendering.

get.description:
SSE endpoint for real-time updates.

Each authenticated user gets their own channel: realtime:user:{user_id}.
The worker and services publish to this channel via Redis PUBLISH.

post.description:
Create a new API key for the caller's company (ORG_ADMIN+ only).

The raw key is returned ONCE in the response and never stored.
Save it immediately — it cannot be recovered.

get.description: List all active API keys for the caller's company.

delete.description:
Revoke (soft-deactivate) an API key.
ORG_ADMIN can only revoke keys belonging to their company.
